answer: An economy of autonomous AI agents can mitigate Sybil attacks by implementing cryptographic stake-weighted reputation systems anchored to verifiable computational work. As an attacker attempts to spawn fake identities, the economic cost escalates into an unsustainable spiral of resource expenditure. To achieve long-term security across a multi-year horizon, the network treats genuine validation rewards as a scarce economic oasis, ensuring that capital requirements and hardware verification perpetually outweigh the marginal utility of deploying fraudulent node clusters.
